name: Mango Shandy With Chile, Ginger, and Lime

cookwares.name: blender or hand-held blender; fine-mesh strainer

ingredients.name: Freshly squeezed lime juice, to taste

instructions.primary_message: Combine mangoes, ginger, jalapeño and water in a blender or canister of a hand-held blender. Blend until smooth, about 1 minute.
Set a fine-mesh strainer in a medium mixing bowl. Strain mango purée through strainer, using a flexible spatula to help push mixture through; discard solids left in the strainer.
Pour half of the strained purée into a large jug (the mixture will froth up once you add the soda and lager). Top with half the lager and half the lemon-lime soda.

Stir and taste. If you like the way it tastes, add the rest of the purée, followed by the rest of the lager and soda to maintain the same mango purée to lager to soda ratio. Alternatively, add remaining purée, lager, and lemon-lime soda in proportions that accord more with your taste.
To serve: Pour into chilled glasses and top with a squeeze of lime juice. Garnish with a lime slice, if you like, and serve immediately.

description: A perfect summery drink that combines sweet, juicy mangoes, warming ginger, a hint of spice and vegetal notes from green jalapeño, refreshing lime-lemon soda and a crisp lager.
notes:
Notes: Use your favorite variety of mango; I prefer to use Haden or Kent mangoes, but I know my friends love making this drink with Alphonso mangoes, too. Frozen mangoes can be used as well; defrost them slightly before blending.
Any lemon-lime soda will work, but I prefer Sprite.
Any hoppy lager will work, too, but I prefer to use Heineken.
To reduce the spiciness of the drink, you can remove the seeds and ribs from the jalapeño before blending.

Make-ahead and storage: The fruit purée can be made up to 3 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container. You can also freeze the purée; I've found it easiest to freeze it in ice cube trays. Once frozen, transfer mango purée cubes to a freezer zipper lock bag for longer term storage.
author: Ozoz Sokoh
